name: Banjo
group: Things people make > Toys > Make music with it > Pluck or strum strings

features.claim: A thin membrane is stretched over a frame or cavity to make its resonator.
features.quote: The banjo is a stringed musical instrument with a thin membrane stretched over a frame or cavity to form a resonator.
The membrane is typically circular, and in modern forms is usually made of mylar (BOPET), whereas earlier examples of banjos had membranes made of goat skin.

features.claim: It has a neck made of wood.
features.quote: Their African-style instruments were crafted from split gourds with animal skins stretched across them. Strings, from gut or vegetable fibers, were attached to a wooden neck.
